integrity: The arbitrary-current theorem follows from an analytic flux balance; finite numerical examples are not promoted to a universal proof. Originality is qualified best knowledge, with potential implicit coverage by broader flux laws. No independent audit was performed.
limitations: Symmetric single-interface mean-field stationary branch with strictly concave gas current, constant dense speed, Poisson tumble/reset. No dynamical stability, exclusion of nonmonotone shocks, microscopic particle fluctuations, or experimental confirmation is claimed.
title: Flux-shape universality and an \(e\)-threshold for locally reset active-gas droplets
